reason: I already delete those settlement emails because they look like phishing, and a free-during-beta site called lawsuitai.org asking me to make an account so I can go file somewhere else is the same pitch. I assume this is a scam until proven otherwise, and nothing here proves it.
objection: How do you even know I qualify? You don't — the listings aren't verified and I still have to read the official notice myself, which is exactly the mail I already treat as spam.
would_change_my_mind: If a claims administrator I already recognize from a real notice sent me here, I could open the official form with no account, and it was obviously for a bank or store I actually use.
